svg.text: Each square = 1 stitch. Read row 1 (bottom) upwards; right-side rows right–to–left, wrong-side rows left–to–right.
Gauge 20 sts × 28 rows = 10 cm, so a stitch is wider than it is tall. The chart is drawn at that gauge, so the beans
appear in the finished fabric in exactly the proportions shown here, S-shaped groove and all.
Work 40 sts wide; repeat the 44-row chart once for the body, then add a button band / seam as desired.
